name: Erlebnispark Hög Serfaus
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnispark Hög in Serfaus at 1,820 m: idyllic Högsee with boats, Schneisenfeger family coaster, woodcutter area, and family recreation.
beschreibung:
Overview

The expansive Erlebnispark Hög is situated on a sunny high plateau at an elevation of 1,820 meters around picturesque Högsee in the Tyrolean municipality of Serfaus (Landeck district). As a premier feature of the family-friendly Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski dimension, this leisure park merges alpine mountain scenery with innovative nature and fun sport attractions. Centered around the crystal-clear, 14-meter-deep reservoir and bathing lake, everything revolves around alpine forestry, timber rafting, and refreshing water activities set against the majestic mountain panorama of the Samnaungruppe and Ötztaler Alpen.

Högsee & Schneisenfeger Family Coaster

The centerpiece of the park is idyllic Högsee: an artificial mountain lake boasting outstanding water quality, inviting visitors to swim in summer with shallow-water bays and bathing piers. A boat rental offers pedal boats, rowboats, and Stand-Up-Paddles (SUP) for lake excursions. For young explorers and nature lovers, the interactive Holzknecht-Areal was created: here, children and adults can experience traditional lumberjack craftsmanship at lovingly designed adventure stations, navigate a wooden obstacle course, uncover the secrets of tree growth rings on a giant tree trunk, and play in a wooden show dairy. The absolute premier attraction for thrill-seekers is the year-round Familien-Coaster Schneisenfeger: this alpine coaster starts right at the lakeside; an inclined lift first pulls the sleds up to the Alpkopf (1,890 m), from where riders race down toward the lake at up to 40 km/h across steep curves, jumps, tunnels, and two spectacular 360-degree loops. A floating meditation chapel by the lake invites quiet reflection.

Visit & Getting There

Erlebnispark Hög is open during the summer season from mid-June to mid-October daily from 08:30 to 17:00. Admission to Erlebnispark Hög, the sunbathing lawns, and the Holzknecht adventure playground is free. Separate fares apply for using the mountain cable cars and the Schneisenfeger family coaster. Schneisenfeger single ride (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €9.50, children (born 2011–2018) approx. €6.50. Holders of the regional Super. Sommer. Card. enjoy unlimited free rides on cable cars throughout Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis. Getting there by cable car: ride the Alpkopfbahn from the Serfaus valley station directly to the Hög mid-station (approx. 6 minutes ride). Getting there by car: take the B180 (Reschenstraße) to Ried im Oberinntal, then follow the mountain road up to Serfaus to the large parking areas at the village entrance (Serfaus is traffic-calmed; take the Dorfbahn Serfaus underground railway to the cable car valley station).

Tips

The entire area surrounding Högsee, the lakeside restaurant, and the paths through the Holzknecht park are barrier-free and easy to navigate with strollers and wheelchairs. Stop by the Seealm Hög right by the water's edge to savor Tyrolean pike-perch fillet, wood-fired pizza, or Kaiserschmarrn on the spacious sun terrace with views across the lake.
